name: nodessh
description: A modern web-based MobaXterm alternative with SSH, SFTP, Tunneling, Key Management, and Multi-user SSO

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
